purpose: Pin what the modelled `test` operators do, measured against the shell builtin and the external utility, so the operator table can be checked against a measurement rather than against a reading of the specification.
note: `[` is a builtin and never reaches the PATH lookup, so the builtin column is the one de-shell models. The external column is measured too: an operator where they disagree is a difference this tool exists to report, not one to model away.
